limitations.title: Five-brand catalog only.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: Requests that do not explicitly name a supported brand receive UNSUPPORTED_SCOPE and no authenticity verdict.

limitations.title: No verified product or SKU identity.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: The same physical watch can appear in more than one split without being detectable as the same SKU.

limitations.title: No marketplace or source metadata.
limitations.current_status: Marketplace and source fields are UNKNOWN in the v2 manifest.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: Marketplace shift cannot be measured from the training catalog.

limitations.title: No product-disjoint guarantee.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: In-distribution perfection can reflect repeated products as well as brand-level signal.

limitations.title: Real OOD validation failed in Phase 35.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: Open-set rejection is not a supported behavior. production_ood_threshold stays null.

limitations.title: Independent watch-like OOD validation remains unresolved because of corpus constraints.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: Phase 36 cannot clear Phase 35, and no replacement corpus is locked.

limitations.title: Resize/recompression false-fake limitation.
limitations.current_status: 8 of 9 known stress false-fake events are caught. Label_0_Watches/Richard Mille/9eda705bd8c9.jpg resize_recompression remains uncovered.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: Robustness is pass-with-limitations. One known false-fake stress case is still missed.

limitations.title: Production serving remains DINOv2 while the frozen candidate uses DINOv3.
limitations.current_status: Live backend files were not switched.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: Customer traffic does not run the frozen DINOv3 checkpoint.

limitations.title: ONNX CUDA unavailable.
limitations.current_status: CPU ONNX is not the authoritative path. CUDA ONNX was not available.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: No production ONNX CUDA parity for the frozen candidate.

limitations.title: TensorRT unavailable.
limitations.current_status: No TensorRT engine is the authoritative runtime.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: The planned TensorRT serving path is not in place.

limitations.title: Triton unavailable.
limitations.current_status: Triton is not serving the frozen DINOv3 candidate.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: The live Triton path, when used, is the DINOv2 stack, not this candidate.

limitations.title: Review workload not formally accepted.
limitations.current_status: Expected review volume was reported and not accepted.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: A shadow REVIEW state has no accepted operational owner.

limitations.title: Formal policy approval not obtained.
limitations.current_status: POLICY_APPROVAL is PENDING. PRODUCTION_PROMOTION is FORBIDDEN.
limitations.effect_on_deployment: No policy document authorizes customer-facing authenticity decisions.
